title: Recipe 07 — Autonomous Research (a goal, a budget, and cited snippets)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Recipe 07 is bounded autonomy: hand it a goal, cap the fan-out and the wall clock, and get a report whose every claim points at a verbatim snippet.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed recipe is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — the planner is a model call, so a real run needs Anthropic credentials.

groups.title: Beat 1 · The spec — a research contract

beats.label: Name it, pick the shape
beats.cue: “target: research” — plan, branch per sub-question, cite, write the report.

beats.label: Teach the Source + CiteFact discipline
beats.cue: “The two auto-injected tools are the whole contract: load a source, then cite verbatim from it. The prompt is where that discipline lives.”

beats.label: Give it the goal and the budget
beats.cue: “One goal, three sub-questions, four minutes of wall clock. Autonomy without a ceiling is an outage waiting to happen.”

beats.label: Fence the sources
beats.cue: “allowedFileRoots is the fence: a Source(file://…) outside it comes back as a tool error, not a file.”

beats.label: Re-root the fence for this directory
beats.cue: “One edit the recipe's own text calls for: that path is written repo-root-relative, and roots resolve against the process cwd — which here is the driver's own directory.”

beats.label: Open the corpus it is fenced to
beats.cue: “Three small markdown files. Every citation in the report has to be a substring of one of them.”

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Parse plus the IR passes the compile path skips — nothing emitted yet.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “Goal, branching factor, duration cap and the file fence — 33 lines of IR, nothing else.”

verify.note: prints the IR for target research (33 lines)

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts the shape, installs the deps and boots it: GREEN, no key needed.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (7 anchors); install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Open the emitted agent
beats.cue: “Planner, crawler, citation tracker, report writer — four imports and the loop that drives them. ALLOWED_FILE_ROOTS is the fence we just re-pointed, baked in as a literal.”

beats.label: Try crewhaus run first
beats.cue: “Deliberate rejection, exit 1: only cli and browser run straight from the spec. Research is compile-first.”

verify.note: measured: `crewhaus run supports target: cli or browser (got "research")`

beats.label: Boot it with the key scrubbed
beats.cue: “The run opens, the goal is already in it, the plan is about to fan out three ways — and then it stops at the credentials gate. Exit 1, on purpose.”
beats.command: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN bun live/dist/agent.ts > live/plan.log 2>&1

verify.note: measured exit 1: emits run_start (with the baked goal) and plan_start branchingFactor 3, then hits the provider credentials gate. Scrubbed explicitly because the Setup group already sourced .env into this shell.

beats.label: Read what it emitted before the gate
beats.cue: “runId, the whole goal verbatim, and the fan-out. That is the contract, printed before a single token is spent.”

beats.label: Run it for real
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Planner spawns three sub-questions, each loads the fenced sources, each cites verbatim, then the report writer assembles one markdown file.”

verify.note: plan → branch per sub-question → report; needs Anthropic credentials

beats.label: Read the report
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Goal, one section per sub-question, then the citation block. No preamble, no synthesis pass.”

verify.note: newest report only — a bare */report.md glob would cat every earlier run on a re-take. The directory only exists after the run beat above.

groups.title: One more thing · the goal is a flag

beats.label: Override the goal and the fan-out
beats.cue: “Same bundle, new goal, sequential instead of three-wide — no recompile. Still exit 1 with no key, which is how you know the flags landed before anything was spent.”
beats.command: env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN bun live/dist/agent.ts --goal "Which target shapes are still planned, and what ships each one?" --branching 1 > live/override.log 2>&1

verify.note: measured exit 1: run_start carries the flag goal, plan_start carries branchingFactor 1, then the credentials gate

beats.label: Prove the fan-out changed
beats.cue: “branchingFactor: 1. Sequential and debuggable is the setting to iterate a prompt on; three-wide is what you record.”
